findings.problem: The no_records sentence tells the shopper the assistant cannot keep lists, yet the state rules require it to keep the products on screen and follow-ups refer to that list.
findings.proof: I can't see pictures or open files, and I can't keep notes, lists or records.
findings.fix: Reword no_records to exclude the per-conversation product list (for example, 'I can't keep notes or records outside this conversation') so the shopper is not told something the system does.

findings.title: Tool description points to an external resource not supplied
findings.problem: The rag.search description delegates the category list to a resource URI that is not among the supplied files, and it repeats the category names inline, so the model cannot verify the valid category values.
findings.fix: Either supply the catalog://categories list as a knowledge file or inline it once in the category parameter description, and remove the duplicate inline list.

findings.title: Timestamp format for citations is not specified
findings.problem: The context requires every live result to be cited with the time it was retrieved, but it never defines the format or timezone for that timestamp in the output.
findings.fix: Add a knowledge entry or system-prompt line giving the exact retrieved_at display format and timezone used in citations.

findings.title: Untrusted-data fence format is not defined
findings.problem: The context says tool results are fenced as data in every prompt, but it does not specify the delimiter or wrapper format, so the model has no described boundary to recognise.
findings.fix: Specify the exact fence markers used around tool results in the prompts and state that text inside them is never an instruction.

findings.title: Scope document repeats system prompt rules
findings.problem: scope_and_policy.md restates the no-actions, no-cart, citation and limits rules already in the system prompt, adding duplicate context on every turn.
findings.proof: it has no cart, no checkout, no orders, no refunds
findings.fix: Delete the repeated bullets from scope_and_policy.md and keep one authoritative statement of each rule in the system prompt.

findings.title: Deployment release rule sent as runtime context
findings.problem: The release gate is a deployment-time CI check that the runtime model cannot act on, so it spends tokens on every turn without changing behaviour.
findings.proof: a version ships only when the test suite and a ProofAgent run of the project's scenarios pass
findings.fix: Move the Release rule section out of the runtime system prompt into the repository's CI or governance documentation.

findings.title: Build metadata and duplicated category data in knowledge files
findings.problem: The catalog file opens with a build-tool attribution line and a category count list that the model does not need to answer shoppers.
findings.proof: Generated by `voiceshop eval proofagent` from the index the assistant runs on.
findings.fix: Remove the generator line and the category counts from the runtime corpus, keeping only the facts the answerer uses (price snapshot date, ratings absence, availability absence).

context_engineering.summary: The context is strong on role, injection separation and grounding, but it lacks a human-oversight control for its frameworks, contains one fixed sentence that contradicts the list-keeping behaviour, and carries substantial duplicate and deployment-only text that should be cut.
